title: She Survived the Titanic… and Its Two Sister Ships 🚢 #shorts
cast: a kind young woman with dark wavy hair tied back, wearing a 1910s white nurse-style stewardess uniform and cap

lines.say: This woman was on the Titanic when it sank. That wasn't even her first shipwreck.
shots: {hero} standing calmly on the tilted deck of a huge sinking ocean liner at night, lifeboats below
close-up of {hero} looking straight at the camera, icy sea and stars behind

lines.say: Violet Jessop worked as a stewardess for the White Star Line, on three giant sister ships.
shots: three enormous ocean liners side by side in a harbour, black hulls, four tall funnels, sunny
{hero} carrying a tray of teacups along a grand ship corridor

lines.say: In 1911, she was aboard the Olympic when it crashed into a warship. The ship made it back to port.
shots: a giant ocean liner scraping against a grey navy warship, sparks and splashing water
{hero} gripping a railing as the ship shakes, teacups flying

lines.say: The next year, she joined the Titanic. When it hit the iceberg, she was ordered into lifeboat sixteen.
shots: a giant iceberg towering over an ocean liner at night, cold blue moonlight
{hero} sitting in a crowded lifeboat holding a bundled baby, the liner lit up in the distance

lines.say: She said an officer handed her a baby to look after. She was rescued the next morning.
shots: a rescue ship arriving at sunrise among small lifeboats on a calm sea
{hero} wrapped in a blanket on a rescue ship deck, sunrise behind

lines.say: Then, in 1916, she was a nurse on the third sister, the Britannic, when it struck a mine and sank.
shots: a white hospital ship with red crosses exploding from a mine, war time sea
{hero} jumping from a lifeboat into the water, the ship tilting behind her

lines.say: She went back to sea, again and again, and lived to the age of eighty-three.
shots: {hero} older with grey hair, smiling on a sunny ship deck, seagulls
an old lady in a cosy garden cottage with a model ship on the windowsill

lines.say: Three disasters, three survivals. Would you ever step on a ship again?
shots: {hero} waving from the deck of a ship sailing into a golden sunset
three tiny model ships in a row on a shelf, soft light

description:
Violet Jessop was aboard the Olympic when it collided with HMS Hawke (1911), survived the Titanic (1912) and the sinking of the Britannic (1916). A true story.

Sources: Encyclopedia Titanica; Wikipedia: Violet Jessop.

Made with AI-assisted pictures and voice.
